lots.key_photo_findings: Photo 1: printed Xbox One outer box present, statue displayed out of its box (inner foam not seen), steelbook with phoenix emblem and 'UNSC' on the spine, a standard retail Halo 5 disc case (AU M rating) with an EB Games exclusive pre-order card. The LCE shipped with a digital game code, so the retail disc is an extra. Statue: both figures, weapons and arch appear intact at this resolution. Heroes VII: stone-look cube box, hardback artbook, DVD game, soundtrack sleeve and a stained-glass card; no figurine visible.
